structure: Part 3 of 6: the whole 'Reason of Import' section of Confluence page "Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields - V4", version 210 (bytes 82,452-102,284 of .result.body, ~19.8 KB). Read in full: the h1 'Reason of Import' (local-id 8c0a36625775), its single intro paragraph (local-id ec5bbf9723c9), and the one table in the section (ac:local-id 9f4053113919) end to end — its header row, its full-width banner row, and all 19 data rows. The table has the same 8 columns as the Live Animal Data Elements table in part 2: Field Name | Type | Conditions / Values | Applies at: | Source | Mandatory | Example | Impacts. The banner row spans all 8 columns and reads 'Reason of Import | Field Block - Mandatory to Submit - At least one'. The 19 data rows make up 5 fields, the first two using rowspans so that one field occupies several rows, one permitted value per row, each value row carrying its own ANIMALS and/or GERMINALS status macros in Impacts: (1) Reason for import (anchor reason_for_import), enum (single-select), 5 value rows — Internal market [ANIMALS, GERMINALS], Transhipment or onward travel [ANIMALS], Transit [ANIMALS, GERMINALS], Re-entry [ANIMALS], Temporary admission horses [ANIMALS]; (2) Purpose in internal market (anchor purpose_in_internal_market), enum (single-select), 11 value rows — Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift [ANIMALS, GERMINALS], Transfer of ownership - Rescue [ANIMALS], Breeding [ANIMALS, GERMINALS], Research [ANIMALS, GERMINALS], Racing, competition, show or training [ANIMALS], Approved premises or body [ANIMALS], Companion animal not for resale or rehoming [ANIMALS], Production [ANIMALS, GERMINALS], Slaughter [ANIMALS], Fattening [ANIMALS], Restocking [ANIMALS]; (3) Destination country, one row; (4) Port of exit, one row; (5) Exit date, one row. 5 + 11 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 19 data rows, all accounted for. The section contains no 'expand' macro and no nested commodity-code list, so the slice's only collapsed content is none: every cell is visible text plus the 26 ANIMALS/GERMINALS status macros. The section carries no page-level or section-level status macro (no Draft, Proposed or Superseded), so no claim here rests on an unapproved decision. Permitted values are written inside <code> tags, so they are literal values rather than prose. Only the first two fields carry an anchor macro (a system field name); Destination country, Port of exit and Exit date are named in prose only. The section stops at the close of that table (two empty paragraphs), after which the h1 'Animal Identifiers' begins part 4. Covered: the intro statement, the banner row, every column of all 5 fields (Type, Conditions/Values, Applies at, Source, Mandatory, Example, Impacts), all 16 permitted values with their per-value journey markers, and 7 gap claims for what the section leaves unsaid.

claims.statement: The example value given for Exit date is 27/03/2026.
claims.ref: §Reason of Import, table ac:local-id 9f4053113919, row "Exit date", column "Example"

claims.statement: Exit date applies to both the animals journey and the germinals journey.
claims.ref: §Reason of Import, table ac:local-id 9f4053113919, row "Exit date", column "Impacts"
claims.note: Impacts cell holds two status macros: ANIMALS (Blue) and GERMINALS (Green). Quote is the two macro titles. Worth noting against claim confluence-6497338582-p3-016: Temporary admission horses, the only reason that triggers this field, is marked ANIMALS only, so the germinals marking here has no reason that can trigger it.

claims.statement: The page gives no bound on Exit date beyond the format: it does not say whether the date must be in the future, nor how it relates to the arrival date at port.
claims.ref: §Reason of Import, table ac:local-id 9f4053113919, row "Exit date", column "Conditions / Values"
claims.quote: Must be a valid date in DD/MM/YYYY format.

claims.statement: The page names no additional field that Re-entry brings into the journey, although the section's intro says additional fields may be displayed depending on the reason selected.
claims.ref: §Reason of Import, table ac:local-id 9f4053113919, all four conditional rows against the "Re-entry" value row (ac:local-id 156429216150)
claims.quote: Depending on the reason selected, additional fields may be displayed and completed before the notification can be submitted
claims.note: The four conditional fields in the section are triggered by Internal market, Transit, Transhipment or onward travel and Temporary admission horses. Re-entry is the one permitted value with no conditional field of its own anywhere in this section.

claims.statement: The page gives no system field name for Destination country, Port of exit or Exit date, although it gives one for Reason for import (reason_for_import) and Purpose in internal market (purpose_in_internal_market).
claims.ref: §Reason of Import, table ac:local-id 9f4053113919, column "Field Name" of rows "Destination country", "Port of exit" and "Exit date"
claims.quote: Destination country / Port of exit / Exit date
claims.note: The first two fields' Field Name cells each hold an anchor macro and an in-page link; these three hold plain text only. Quote assembled from the three Field Name cells.

claims.statement: The page gives no validation error message wording for any field in the Reason of Import section, including for a missing reason for import, a missing conditional field or a malformed exit date.
claims.ref: §Reason of Import, table ac:local-id 9f4053113919, whole table: no column carries error wording and no row states one
